# xqshare browser assets

- Package: `xqshare@0.1.3`
- Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/xqshare>
- Browser entry: `lib/js/xqshare.min.js` (`window.XqShare`)
- Stylesheet: `lib/css/xqshare.min.css`
- Icons: `lib/img/share_*.png`
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`

The browser UMD build, stylesheet, and bundled icons are kept locally so the
case works without a runtime CDN request.
